summary: Tested live SkillMatch backend and browser workflows for volunteer and organizer roles. Core auth, event browsing/search, application, certificate display, organizer event creation, management view, logout/error handling, and mobile rendering passed.

minor.issue: Returns 200 {ok:true} even when no accepted application exists for the supplied event/user; should return 404 or 409 and avoid marking the event completed.

ui_bugs.issue: Literal and tags render in the visible heading instead of emphasized text.

action_items: Validate that completion targets an existing accepted application before returning success.
Render the welcome heading emphasis as JSX rather than literal string markup.
critical_code_review_comments: Completion endpoint currently ignores update_one matched count and can falsely complete an event with no accepted volunteer.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST event records through organizer API/UI during testing; no user seed changes. Existing seeded Maya application was completed by the test flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth and primary volunteer/organizer flows passed. Re-test completion validation and heading rendering after fixes; organizer pending Maya application is available for accept/reject testing.
rca of the issue: The heading uses a JavaScript string containing '...' in App.js, which React escapes as text. The completion handler performs update_one without checking matched_count, then always updates the event and returns success.
